programme.title: IMPACT Wrestling
programme.desc: IMPACT Wrestling's flagship weekly show features addictive storylines, awe-inspiring athleticism and larger-than-life personalities. Some of the top professional wrestling stars showing off their skills include Eric Young, Doc Gallows, Karl Anderson, Rhino, Moose, Sami Callihan, Eddie Edwards and Rich Swann. Also spotlighted are the high-flying X-Division and the Knockouts, including Deonna Purrazzo, Rosemary and Tenille Dashwood.
